comment: MEASURED (suite source AbstractVerifyScopesReturnedInClaims.java): the condition requires userinfo to carry ALL 14 profile standard claims (name, given_name, family_name, middle_name, nickname, profile, picture, website, gender, birthdate, zoneinfo, locale, updated_at, preferred_username) whenever `profile` is requested. The user model holds only `name`, and OIDC Core 5.3.2 forbids null/empty placeholders, so this warning is honest until the profile model grows. THE-CONSENTED-SCOPE gated `name` under the profile scope; that does not change this condition.

DELIBERATE posture, not a defect: the OP stamps the session's REAL acr and refuses to echo a requested acr_values it did not perform — faking authentication context would be worse than this warning (acr is a voluntary claim).
